results.name: Launcher lists the four apps and resets demo data
Portal: protected routes redirect to sign-in
Portal: sign in with email, password and 2-step code
Guard: wrong PIN is refused, right PIN signs in
Resident: sign in with phone and SMS code
Walk-in: guard scans ID, checks face, asks A-15-07; resident approves in the app; guard checks in; portal sees visitor
Invite: resident creates a pass; visitor opens it and adds a selfie; guard verifies by PIN and checks in; resident is notified
SOS: resident holds SOS; guard tablet gets banner and responds; resident sees each step; closed
Parcel: guard logs a parcel; resident sees the code; guard hands over by code; resident history updates
Renovation: resident applies; manager approves in the portal; resident pays deposit; permit active
Announcement: manager composes; resident receives it
Unregistered gallery: add unknown person to watchlist; appears on the watchlist page
Facility booking: resident books BBQ pit; manager sees it on the bookings timeline
Billing: resident pays the Q4 bill by FPX and downloads the receipt
Patrol: guard verifies next checkpoint; portal patrol matrix updates
Face access: resident enrols with consent, then deletes
Incident: manager acknowledges, dispatches and closes an alert with outcome; evidence pack downloads
Guardhouse messages: resident messages the guardhouse; guard replies on the tablet; resident sees the reply
Defect report: resident reports a problem with a photo; manager sees it and updates it; resident is notified
Move-in: resident books the service lift and pays the deposit; manager approves; lorry is expected at the gate; inspection closes it and refunds
Limits: manager lowers visitor and car limits in Site settings; the resident app enforces them; limits restored
Multi-day pass: resident invites a guest for three days; the pass shows the last day
e-Voting: resident votes in the app; manager records a proxy vote, closes voting; resident sees the result
Rider, drop-off: guard logs a GrabFood rider for the lobby; resident is told; rider checked out
Rider, to the door: guard asks the resident; resident lets the rider up in the app; guard lets the rider up
Offline mode: guard tablet loses the connection, keeps logging a parcel, and syncs when back online
Detection rules: full catalogue incl. audio; manager creates a compound rule that alerts only after midnight
Reports: the same report downloads as a real PDF, Excel and CSV file; pilot metrics are shown
Parcel locker: guard puts a parcel in a smart locker; resident opens the locker from the app
UHF tag, accounts and integrations: manager issues a windscreen tag, downloads the strata statement, tests a connection
Map timeline: evidence search shows a person's sightings numbered on the site map
Video intercom: visitor calls A-15-07 from the lobby panel; resident answers and opens the door; guard call declined
Courier pass: resident creates a single-use code; guard checks it once with a photo stamp; second use refused
Visitor self-entry: guest types the pass PIN at the Tower A lobby panel and the door opens
Emergency broadcast: manager sends an emergency notice; residents get it as a security notice
Guard shift handover: checklist, sign off, logged out
Roles: JMB/MC committee sees only its pages and approves a watchlist entry; security supervisor sees guards but not residents
Sign out: resident and portal
